definitions.explanation: Describes a surface or texture that is very smooth and fine, with no visible roughness.
Describes service, care, or work that pays attention to every small detail. A highly positive description of someone's approach.

examples.japanese: きめ{細|こま}かい{肌|はだ}をしている。
きめ{細|こま}かい{泡|あわ}が{立|た}つ{石鹸|せっけん}だ。
examples.english: It's a soap that produces fine lather.

examples.japanese: この{陶器|とうき}はきめ{細|こま}かい{仕上|しあ}がりが{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: This pottery has a beautiful fine-grained finish.

examples.japanese: きめ{細|こま}かいサービスが{評判|ひょうばん}だ。
examples.english: The attentive service has a good reputation.

examples.japanese: きめ{細|こま}かい{対応|たいおう}に{感謝|かんしゃ}します。
{一人一人|ひとりひとり}にきめ{細|こま}かい{指導|しどう}ができるのは、{少人数|しょうにんずう}クラスの{利点|りてん}だ。
examples.english: Being able to give detailed guidance to each individual is an advantage of small classes.

notes:
USAGE:
きめ{細|こま}かい combines きめ ({木目|きめ}, grain or texture) with {細|こま}かい (fine, detailed). It is often written partly in hiragana. The word works both as a literal description of texture and as a figurative description of thoroughness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- きめ{細|こま}かい{肌|はだ} (fine-grained skin)
- きめ{細|こま}かいサービス (attentive service)
- きめ{細|こま}かい{対応|たいおう} (detailed response)
- きめ{細|こま}かい{指導|しどう} (thorough instruction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{丁寧|ていねい} means polite or careful and focuses on manner and politeness. きめ{細|こま}かい emphasizes paying attention to small details and leaving nothing overlooked.
